name: jiucaibox
description: 韭菜学院 / JiucaiBox —— 一所没有围墙的防割大学（monorepo）

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/admin
scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @jiucaibox/shared && (cd apps/api && npx --yes prisma@6.19.3 generate) && npm run build -w @jiucaibox/api
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build -w @jiucaibox/shared && npm run build -w @jiucaibox/api && npm run build -w @jiucaibox/web && npm run build -w @jiucaibox/admin && node scripts/copy-api-to-vercel.cjs
